messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed at api-gateway.edge (EU-WEST). 1m error rate spike to 12% (baseline 0.3%). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/api-gw/errs?since=5m — paging oncall group @ops-oncall

sarah: I'm oncall, joining. oncall handoff: sarah -> mike in 10m if not resolved.

mike: ack. pulling up logs and routes now. any customer-facing reports yet?

sarah: customer-impact: a subset of tokenization-heavy requests failing with 502/504; web frontends showing 'Service unavailable' for ~10% of EU traffic. CS fwds 2 tickets.

lee: I can see backend pool saturation on the edge LB. connection_attempts spiking and many upstream timeouts to model-proxy replicas. quick query: `sum(rate(envoy_upstream_rq_5xx[1m])) by (cluster)` shows cluster=proxy-model-eu increased 8x.

anya: probable root: model-proxy replicas hitting CPU bound during long-tail inference -- KV-cache misses causing long tail and connections pile up. Suggest throttling long-running requests at gateway and enabling 503 fallback to small-model-variant.

mike: rolling temp mitigation: enable per-route circuit-breaker and reduce max_connections to proxy-model-eu to 200. applying now to canary subset (eu-west-1a).

infra-bot: deploy queued: patch `ingress/circuit-breakers-v2` -> canary eu-west-1a. CI tests ok. ETA 30s to apply.

ops-oncall: +1 for canary. Also reduce client-side timeout from 30s -> 10s for affected route to free up sockets.

sarah: doing timeout change now. command:```sh
kubectl set env deployment/api-gateway GATEWAY_ROUTE_TIMEOUT=10s -n prod-eu
```

lee: after canary patch: 5xx rate in eu-west-1a down from 14% -> 2.1% within 45s. overall eu-west aggregate still at ~7%.

mike: good. can we expand the circuit-breaker patch to all eu-west nodes? risks?

anya: expanding is ok but need to verify GC/CPU on model-proxy; if we throttle too hard we push load to other regions. propose sequential rollout 1 zone at a time plus traffic steering.

mike: doing staged rollout now: eu-west-1b -> eu-west-1c -> global eu. will watch heatmaps.

incident-bot: Observation: rolling changes to ingress/circuit-breakers-v2 increased resource pressure on control-plane (API calls elevated). Throttle API client to 10 TPS.

lee: added temporary traffic-shed rule: route 5% of eu-west traffic to fallback-model-sm (lower-cost/fast) to relieve long tail. config snippet:```json
{"routes": [{"match":"/v1/generate","weight":"95","backend":"model-proxy-eu"},{"match":"/v1/generate","weight":"5","backend":"model-fallback-sm"}]}
```

ops-oncall: Monitoring customer error inbox + heartbeat. CS reports reduced immediate impact for two enterprise customers (Xeno, Drift) after canary.

mike: after full rollout, eu-west 5xx stabilized ~0.9% in last 3m. Latency p50 unchanged, p95 improved from 1.8s -> 1.6s. leaving circuit-breaker live as part of mitigation.

anya: recommend post-incident actions: 1) add KV-cache warmup on model-proxy start, 2) tune auto-scale based on long-tail active requests, 3) add a synthetic that exercises tokenization-long path for regression detection.

sarah: agreed. creating followup ticket: INC-4620198765-postmortem with owners @anya (lead), @lee (infra), @mike (deploy). ETA for postmortem draft: EOD today.

ops-oncall: final check: any lingering rollback needed? I see control-plane throttle warnings cleared.

mike: no rollback. leaving reduced timeouts + circuit-breaker. will monitor for 1h then hand back to normal config if stable.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> Services routing restored. Severity: S2 -> S3. Channel will remain open for 1h for watch. :white_check_mark:
